title: We Have Learned Nothing
body: Interesting piece- it points to the groupthink that is dominant in most modern business strategy. Everyone has read the Lean Startup, every knows their Porter, but when everyone is playing from the same playbook, what relative advantage does that actually provide? Business school strategies are table stakes.
